thread:
maya: heads-up: our scanner flagged a surge of GETs to a public bucket that contains build artifacts. seeing paths that look like `secrets-backup/staging/*`. probable leak of KMS-wrapped vault exports. :eyes:

ishaan: can you paste the alert and affected object keys? also, do we have any live pods still mounting those artifacts?

maya: alert: https://alerts.internal/INC-8342 (copied below). affected objects: `s3://redwood-staging-artifacts/secrets-backup/2026-03-20.tar.gz` and `.../2026-03-19.tar.gz`. I downloaded a listing and a tiny sample (no plaintext creds). looks like KMS-wrapped blobs and a `vault_export.jsonl` inside.

sec-bot: automated detection -> suspicious public access to bucket `redwood-staging-artifacts`. severity: high. recommended immediate actions: 1) restrict bucket ACL, 2) rotate exposed secrets, 3) search audit logs for token use.

oliver: I can take rotation for service-api and job-runner tokens. will create short-lived replacements and update deployments. ETA 2h. :lock:

sabrina: I'll own external integrations and marketplace keys. will coordinate with partners if we need to revoke keys on their side.

ishaan: I'll run audit queries and RBAC recon. initial queries:
```
# Vault audit events: read of secret data
SELECT timestamp, entity_id, path, request_addr FROM vault_audit
WHERE path LIKE 'secret/staging/%' AND event_type='read' AND timestamp > now() - interval '72 hours';
```
and for cloud storage ACLs:
```
# S3 access logs (example)
fields @timestamp, @message | filter bucket = 'redwood-staging-artifacts' and requester_ip != '10.*' | sort @timestamp desc | limit 50
```

maya: also need an RBAC quick-change: remove `build-bot` group from `vault-readers` until we confirm CI didn't push exports. @oncall can you apply an emergency policy update to deny `vault:read` for `build-bot` in staging?

oncall: applying deny policy now to build-bot in staging, will patch in 2 mins and post change-id. :white_check_mark:

sec-bot: noted. created ticket SEC-2026-113 with checklist: bucket ACL, KMS rewrap (if needed), vault rotate, revoke tokens, notify partners, run audit queries, create runbook PR.

oliver: rotation plan (brief):
- create new tokens in vault with `token_ttl=1h` and distribute via secrets-sync job
- update k8s deployments to read new kv paths
- revoke old tokens and purge from Vault
sample command I'll run for service-api: `vault token create -policy="service-api" -ttl=1h -format=json`

sabrina: for partner marketplaces, I'll open auth ticket with them and push rotated keys to their admin UI. will flag any partners that cannot accept immediate rotation.

ishaan: audit findings so far: 6 unique external IPs downloaded artifacts in the last 48h. 3 of those correlate with ephemeral CI runners (suspected leaked pipeline cache). no production access observed. uploading raw query results to SEC drive.

maya: perfect. prioritize: 1) lock bucket ACL, 2) deny build-bot vault reads, 3) rotate staging KV entries, 4) revoke any suspected tokens. after done, we run an integrity check of deployments. target: 4 hours to containment.

oliver: started rotations for service-api and job-runner. posting hashes of new token IDs to SEC ticket (obfuscated).

oncall: deny policy applied: change-id `chg-9921`.

sec-bot: evidence saved to SEC-2026-113. audit logs archived to secure logstore.

sabrina: integrations rotated for marketplace and payments. one partner (payflow) needs 24h to update, flagged in ticket.

maya: good — can someone open a quick post-incident PR to add a pre-commit scan to block `vault_export` artifacts in builds and update infra CI not to upload backups to public buckets? link to PR when ready.

ishaan: will draft PR and runbook update. adding an automated check to block `secrets-backup/*.tar.gz` from being published.

oliver: revokes done for rotated services. leaving a short lived allowlist for the deploy pipeline while we confirm no more artifacts. will remove after CI patch.

maya: thanks team. will follow up with a brief postmortem and next steps: permanent bucket ACL policy + mandatory KMS rewrap workflow for any exported vault data. :rocket:

oncall: containment complete. last check-in at 1745557321. closing thread after postmortem added to SEC ticket.
